WITH listings AS (SELECT "ProdCat", COUNT(*) AS active_listings FROM products GROUP BY "ProdCat"),
tx AS (
  SELECT tp."ProdCat",
         c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type' AS lang_pattern,
         b."AcqCode",
         ((b.buyer_risk_profile->>'behavior_consistency_scr')::numeric < 30
          AND split_part(b.buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric > 0.15) AS is_suspicious_buyer
  FROM transaction_products tp
  JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = tp."EventLink"
  LEFT JOIN communications c ON c."EventLink" = t."EventCode"
  LEFT JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = t."AcqLink"),
m AS (
  SELECT "ProdCat",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lang_pattern='Consistent') AS consistent_lang_txns,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lang_pattern='Suspicious') AS suspicious_lang_txns,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lang_pattern='Variable') AS variable_lang_txns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "AcqCode") FILTER (WHERE is_suspicious_buyer) AS suspicious_buyers
  FROM tx GROUP BY "ProdCat")
SELECT l."ProdCat", l.active_listings, m.consistent_lang_txns, m.suspicious_lang_txns, m.variable_lang_txns, m.suspicious_buyers
FROM listings l LEFT JOIN m ON m."ProdCat" = l."ProdCat"
ORDER BY l.active_listings DESC
note: Suspicious Buyer thresholds (behavior consistency < 30, risk-dollar ratio > 0.15) are assumed; knowledge gives none. 'Metrics related to' language patterns interpreted as per-category transaction counts by pattern.

answer:
SELECT "PlatCode", "PlatName",
  ROUND(((0.4 * (platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric
        + 0.3 * (platform_compliance->>'sec_event_count')::numeric
        + 0.3 * NULLIF(regexp_replace("RepScore", '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric) / 100), 4) AS mrs
FROM markets
ORDER BY mrs DESC NULLS LAST
note: RepScore is text like '$65.20 ' and NULL for 387 markets; MRS is NULL there, sorted last.

SELECT "EventLink",
  ROUND((communication_details->>'keyword_match_count')::numeric / NULLIF((communication_details->>'msg_count_total')::numeric, 0), 3) AS ssd
FROM communications
ORDER BY ssd DESC

WITH price AS (SELECT "SellerPointer", AVG((product_availability->>'price_amt')::numeric) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY "SellerPointer"),
routes AS (SELECT "VendorLink",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "RouteComplex"='Simple') AS simple_routes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "RouteComplex"='Medium') AS medium_routes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "RouteComplex"='Complex') AS complex_routes
  FROM transactions GROUP BY "VendorLink")
SELECT v."SellerKey",
  v."CompletedTxns" * p.avg_price / NULLIF(v."DaysActive", 0) AS plr,
  COALESCE(r.simple_routes,0) AS simple_routes, COALESCE(r.medium_routes,0) AS medium_routes, COALESCE(r.complex_routes,0) AS complex_routes
FROM vendors v
LEFT JOIN price p ON p."SellerPointer" = v."SellerKey"
LEFT JOIN routes r ON r."VendorLink" = v."SellerKey"
ORDER BY plr DESC NULLS LAST
note: average_price taken as vendor's average product price_amt; successful_txns = CompletedTxns.

WITH b AS (
  SELECT "AcqCode", NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric) AS tile
  FROM buyers),
tx AS (
  SELECT b.tile, b."AcqCode", t."CrossBorder",
    CASE WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 4 THEN 'Medium' WHEN cs."AnonLevel" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Low' END AS anon
  FROM b LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."AcqLink" = b."AcqCode"
  LEFT JOIN connection_security cs ON cs."TxnPointer" = t."EventCode")
SELECT CASE tile WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS brdr_bucket,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "AcqCode") AS buyer_count,
  AVG("CrossBorder"::numeric) AS cross_border_share,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anon='High') AS high_anonymity_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anon='Medium') AS medium_anonymity_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anon='Low') AS low_anonymity_sessions
FROM tx GROUP BY tile ORDER BY tile
note: No bucket thresholds given; tertiles (NTILE 3) of risk_dollar_ratio used. AnonLevel is numeric 1-10; binned Low<4, Medium<7, High>=7 (assumed).

SELECT cs."TxnPointer",
  split_part(cs."Threat_handle_rate", ' ', 1)::numeric AS thr,
  b."AuthLevel"
FROM connection_security cs
JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = cs."TxnPointer"
LEFT JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = t."AcqLink"
ORDER BY thr DESC
note: THR read from stored Threat_handle_rate (unit stripped); no threats_handled/hours columns exist.

SELECT m."PlatCode", m."PlatName", m."OperStatus",
  COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'escalation_tier_stat' = 'Level3') AS tier3_cases,
  COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Critical') AS critical_alerts,
  COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'High') AS high_alerts,
  COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Medium') AS medium_alerts,
  COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Low') AS low_alerts
FROM markets m
LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."PlatformKey" = m."PlatCode"
LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a."EventTag" = t."EventCode"
WHERE (m.platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::int < 10
  AND (m.platform_compliance->>'protection_meas_count')::int > 15
GROUP BY m."PlatCode", m."PlatName", m."OperStatus"

SELECT "RouteComplex", COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions GROUP BY "RouteComplex" ORDER BY transaction_count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN "AnonLevel"::numeric >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN "AnonLevel"::numeric >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS anonymity_level,
  ROUND(AVG("OpSecMetric")::numeric, 2) AS avg_opsec
FROM connection_security
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_opsec DESC
note: AnonLevel is numeric 1-10; binned Low<4, Medium<7, High>=7 (assumed).
